```sql
SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c_num.isReserved = 1 THEN c_num.id END) AS DOUBLE) / 
  NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c_den.id), 0) AS collector_premium
FROM main.sets s
LEFT JOIN main.cards c_num ON c_num.setCode = s.code
LEFT JOIN main.cards c_den ON c_den.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-02-01' 
  AND s.releaseDate < '2017-03-01'
```
